title: Find out whether Escape closes the Sections list
goal: The list of panel sections opens from a row at the foot of the right hand panel. Pressing Escape should close it, the way Escape closes anything else that pops up. In a scripted run it does not: the list stays open and the thing you had selected on the canvas gets deselected instead. Nobody knows yet whether that happens to a person at the keyboard too, because the Mac has been locked and the app could not be driven by hand.
notes:
Reproduced in the harness, not by hand. /tmp/reopen-test.json: press "Sections", snapshot, key escape, snapshot, press "Sections" again, expect "Use Automatic For All". Output:

  [23 expect] FAILED: no control called "Use Automatic For All" is in the panel

and reopen-2-closed-sc.png, taken AFTER the escape, shows the list still fully on screen with the rectangle no longer selected and Appearance/Effects/Motion gone from the panel behind it. So the escape reached the canvas, not the popover, and the second press on the row toggled isOpen back to false rather than reopening.

The likely innocent explanation: PlaytestHarness posts key events at the EDITOR window (keyEvent(..., in: window)), and a SwiftUI .popover lives in a window of its own, so the walk can never deliver a key to it. That would make this a harness limitation and not an app bug, which is why this is filed as a question at p2 rather than as a bug. It cannot be settled without driving the app by hand, and the screen has been locked since 2026-09-15 08:44.

PanelSectionsFooter.swift: Button { isOpen.toggle() } with .popover(isPresented: $isOpen). panel-sections-walk.json now closes the list by pressing the Sections row a second time, so it passes; put Escape back when this is answered.
acceptance: Somebody has opened the Sections list by hand and pressed Escape, and written down what happened
If Escape leaves the list open for a person too, it closes the list and leaves the canvas selection alone
The walk Scripts/playtest/panel-sections-walk.json goes back to closing the list with Escape once that works
